attributes.Notes: miRNA counts from mirtop, isomiRs collapsed to their miRNA. Quantified against miRBase (or MirGeneDB), not the genome.

GCPercent.note: FastQC on the raw reads; single-end runs write it on the sample row, paired-end on <sample>_1 (@R1)

F_bp.note: mean read-1 length (FastQC per-read row, else the single-end sample row)

Q30Percent.note: fastp's base-level Q30 rate, written as a percentage by MultiQC

MismatchPercent.note: unverified: smrnaseq's samtools rows may be named <sample>_mature..., not the sample

deliberately_unmapped.why: Sequence-level duplication before alignment; DuplicationPercent is alignment-based (Picard), and mixing the two definitions in one field would mislead.
